comment:
* Shared constants related to Unused App Restrictions
 * (e.g. Permission Revocation, App Hibernation).

variables.name: ERROR
variables.comment:
* The status of Unused App Restrictions could not be retrieved from this app.
     *
     * Note: check the logs for the reason (e.g. if the app's target SDK version < 30 or the user
     * is in locked device boot mode).

variables.name: FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE
variables.comment: There are no available Unused App Restrictions for this app.

variables.name: DISABLED
variables.comment:
* Any available Unused App Restrictions on the device are disabled for this app.
     *
     * In other words, this app is exempt from having its permissions automatically removed
     * or being hibernated.

variables.name: API_30_BACKPORT
variables.comment: * Unused App Restrictions introduced by Android API 30, and since made available on earlier * (API 23-29) devices are enabled for this app: * permission auto-reset. * * Note: This value is only used on API 29 or earlier devices.

variables.name: API_30
variables.comment: * Unused App Restrictions introduced by Android API 30 are enabled for this app: * permission auto-reset. * * Note: This value is only used on API 30 or later devices.

variables.name: API_31
variables.comment: * Unused App Restrictions introduced by Android API 31 are enabled for this app: * permission auto-reset and * app hibernation. * * Note: This value is only used on API 31 or later devices.
